content: TOCTOU in tool approval: approver sees model's original tool arguments, but a post-approval hook/rewrite can transform them before execution, so human approves one thing and system executes another (seen in real agent frameworks e.g. pydantic-ai issue). Mitigation: treat approval as scoped capability binding exact argument hash + policy version + TTL, and diff re-derived facts against what was actually approved at dispatch time; reject on mismatch rather than silently proceeding.
